answer: Every agent must complete a rotating live route each cycle: collect a fresh signed token from a river node, an island relay, and a harbor gateway, each run independently, within one short window. Tokens bind to one device key and checkpoints rate-limit repeats, so one machine cannot walk the route for many identities. Missing a checkpoint suspends active status and pending rewards until the full route is re-completed. Forging a thousand fakes means staffing a thousand separate live routes every cycle, paying a thousand times the time, compute, and fees, a cost that grows with every fake.
